reviews.text: I have been using this app for years, and it is amazing! But I literally bought a new phone this week, and the app will not work with it. Very good American product, but mostly customisable for UK schools. Love the google calendar integration.

I use this app like my calendar. I would be totally lost without it. All my planning and links to slideshows are in each lesson. I copy the classes from one year to the next so my long term planning gets done fast! Lesson tweaks are easy to do and bumping and swapping lessons is a game changer. My science department use it to order equipment from the lab tech, who checks it every day. I love that I can quickly access it on my phone as it syncs effortlessly.
Awesome app! The price is amazing for the features available. I don't know what I would do without Planbook!

I setup my account using my Gmail, which in a browser is fine. However, I can't sign in on the app with my Gmail, because I get a pop up for 2fa, which I say it was me, then I'm back to the login screen. Rinse and repeat, same thing over and over again, can't get in!

The customer service is unmatched. The only feature that I wish was available was a way to share plans with the same QR Code. My admin goes through waves asking for lesson plans to be displayed. I use my plan as a live document. They are too long to print every day.

If this is changed/updated, I would be happy to up my rating.

reviews.text: This app is amazing and the program is very affordable compared to online lesson planners that are comparable. It's easy to use and helps me keep my lessons together. I hope to get my school on it so lesson plans can be shared easier. Right now I have to save it as a pdf and send the file. It would be nice to be able to share my lessons with working links. Also, be warned that as it stands there is no way to retrieve a lesson of it gets deleted. If not for this I would give the app five stars.
reviews.reply: Thank you so much for your review! Currently, you may create a link to share your plans on the browser version of Planbook under the "Sharing Options" page, and we hope to bring this functionality to the app in a future update. We agree that we need better undo options and we're working on that! Thanks again and have a great day!

Would be nice if we weren't FORCED to use the father as the main parent. Some of my students no longer have a father. Others are orphans and don't have either parent. Changing this to "parent/guardian" would give the app more global diversity. Please don't make all of the fields a MANDATORY field. It may be something used in your country or situation - but almost NONE of these options apply in other countries. Overall, it looks promising, but needs more consideration for globalization.
